reason: This is a fundamental behavioral change to core content lifecycle events (Updating/Updated no longer fire on creation, requiring separate Creating/Created handling), which will silently break any first-party or third-party content part handlers, workflows, or modules relying on the previous semantics unless they are updated in lockstep.
